bugClass.title: Serial CI job exceeds its time limit
bugClass.cause: A single CI workflow job runs all check stages serially, so adding stages increases total wall time until the job reaches its timeout. The workflow lacks parallel stage splitting or a headroom guard to keep expected runtime below the limit.
bugClass.criteria: A CI workflow places multiple check stages in one job and orders them sequentially, causing their durations to accumulate toward a job-level timeout; the workflow has no parallel split or runtime headroom guard. Either serial accumulation or the missing guard can exhibit the cause.
